findings.claim: Multiple flushes in the same second write the same raw/outbox filename, causing later session notes to overwrite or fail against earlier ones.
findings.evidence: The filename is `${compactTs(now.toISOString())}-agent-activity.md`, and `compactTs` strips fractional seconds with `.replace(/\.\d+Z$/, "Z")` before `writeFileSync(path.join(outbox, name), text)` writes the queued note; the added spec requires each Stop/SessionEnd/PreCompact delta to be summarized and queued as a session note.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep millisecond precision in `compactTs`, or add a monotonic/UUID suffix and use exclusive file creation for raw/outbox note paths.

findings.claim: The added karpathy flush hook is not registered to run at Stop, SessionEnd, or PreCompact, so the new session-note delivery requirement is not satisfied.
findings.evidence: `openspec/specs/agent-tooling/karpathy-logging/spec.md` states: "At `Stop`, `SessionEnd` and `PreCompact`, ledger lines added since the previous flush SHALL be summarized into one session note"; the diff adds `.claude/hooks/src/karpathy-flush.mts` but contains no hunk modifying `.claude/settings.json` or another hook dispatcher to invoke it for those events.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the hook command to `.claude/settings.json` for Stop, SessionEnd, and PreCompact, and include a smoke/test path proving those events invoke `karpathy-flush`.
